# mentis

> React/TypeScript web application built with Vite. Mental wellness and productivity platform.

## Project

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cocodedk/mentis)
- [Website](https://cocodedk.github.io/mentis/)

- [Components](https://github.com/cocodedk/mentis/tree/main/src/components)
- [Pages](https://github.com/cocodedk/mentis/tree/main/src/pages)
- [README](https://github.com/cocodedk/mentis/blob/main/README.md)
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/cocodedk/mentis/blob/main/CLAUDE.md)

## Stack

- React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Vitest (unit tests), GitHub Pages deployment
